description: S462 Q18 — nested gates: the chain of `if=` gates enclosing a handler (innermost to outermost) contributes its narrowings, so a handler inside `if=@user` › `if=@other` reads both bare. Compiles clean; clicking renders both names.
rationale: §42.3.5 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a", Q18): nested gates — the innermost-to-outermost chain of gates that encloses the handler contributes its narrowings.
